tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description: Delete one of your memory entries by name, for example when the user asks you to forget something.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read the full body of one of your memory entries by name (see the memory index).

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Save a long-term memory for this user (new, or overwrite the entry with the same name). name: [a-z0-9-]; type: user, feedback, project, reference; description: one line shown in the index; content: Markdown body.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read a file the user attached, by its read-only path (/attachments/sha256-...). Images are shown to you. Text is cut at 2000 lines or 50 KB, whichever comes first; read in parts with offset and limit.
